newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices firm on low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices firm on low volumes.

text.p: Indian soybean prices remained firm on Monday, gaining by 100-150 rupees per tonne on poor arrivals and low volumes, dealers said.
Soyoil refined was down by 100 rupees per tonne on better demand from refineries. Soyoil solvent was steady.

Soymeal prices were slightly dull on limited enquiry in exports trading. Soymeal yellow was $270 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was $133 per tonne in export on limited demand. Rapeseed extraction was 4,550 rupees per tonne FOR (Free on Rail) Bedibunder and was 4,500-4,525 rupees per tonne FOR Bhavnagar. Business volume was limited and the undertone was weak.
